scoring_rule.name: Brier (pre-declared, applied identically to JEV and lane 37-a)
scoring_rule.noul_questions: B = (p - outcome)^2, outcome in {0,1}; battery score = mean B over resolved noul questions
scoring_rule.d_choice_multiclass: B = sum over options (p_i - y_i)^2, y_i = 1 iff option i matches the guest's actual registered round-8 move
scoring_rule.d_score_absolute_error: AE = |score - realized_level|, realized level from {'gutted':0,'dented':1,'intact':2,'strengthened':3} as judged by the keeper's round-8 seal of the guest's registered answer
scoring_rule.unresolved_policy: A question whose outcome never resolves (deadline passes with no adjudicable event) is excluded from the mean, not scored as 0.5 — declared here so nobody rescues a miss later
